name: Alistair Finch
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport finance began somewhat unconventionally. After graduating with a degree in economics, he initially pursued a career in corporate banking. However, his passion for racing, fuelled by years of attending Silverstone with his father, never waned. He decided to combine his financial acumen with his love for motorsport, taking a significant pay cut to join a smaller racing team.

Alistair thrives on identifying hidden efficiencies and creating innovative financial strategies to optimize team performance. He is known for his meticulous approach and relentless pursuit of value, ensuring that every penny is strategically allocated. His visionary outlook allows him to anticipate future financial challenges and opportunities, making him a valuable asset to any team seeking long-term success.

At ProSport Racing, Alistair has quickly established himself as a key player, streamlining their budgeting process and implementing more robust financial controls. His ability to see the big picture, coupled with his attention to detail, makes him a unique and highly effective finance controller.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the left
physical.description: Alistair is of average height, with a focused and intelligent look.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with financial calculations.
Insists on using a vintage calculator for initial budget drafts.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
